title: KnoverseAI Cognitive Mechanics Telemetry
subtitle: Human vs AI behavioral telemetry from two games — Pathogenika (2D RTS) and PetroActive (3D exploration)
description: Paired human-AI telemetry sessions from two games built for the KnoverseAI Cognitive Mechanics benchmark. Contains 10 Pathogenika sessions (Unity, real-time strategy with immune system cells) and 4 PetroActive sessions (Three.js, mech exploration with radar navigation). Each session captures timestamped behavioral events: unit switching, waypoint navigation, combat, abilities, camera control, and node capture. AI opponent evolved from v1.0 (12% active) to v2.4 (98% active, abilities firing) across telemetry-driven iterations. Session annotations provide corrected metadata including team assignments, AI version, and playerType attribution status. The benchmark measures whether an AI's behavioral trace is structurally comparable to a human's using the same diagnostic framework — decision tempo, action diversity, spatial coverage, and strategic adaptation.
